title: Evaluate league-discriminator schema unification
description: Parallel pred_wnba_* tables added per Plan A. If maintenance cost across NBA+WNBA tables becomes painful, evaluate migrating to a unified schema with a league discriminator column.

title: Evaluate per-book market line storage for WNBA
description: WNBA Plan A stores consensus avg only in pred_wnba_game_lines. If/when UI grows a best-line feature, revisit to store per-book rows like pred_nba_game_lines does.

title: WNBA Phase 2 — player prop models (points/assists/rebounds)
description: Plan B to be written after Plan A ships. Train XGBoost models on 2021-2025 history with hard MAE thresholds (Points <= 4.5, Assists <= 1.5, Rebounds <= 2.0). Schema tables already created in Plan A migration. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-21-wnba-support-design.md.

title: NBA spread/win-prob projector (backport from WNBA)
description: After WNBA Plan A ships, port the WNBA Elo+pace spread/win-prob projector to NBA. NBA currently has only a totals_projector and no own spread/win-prob model. Lives in app/services/etl/nba/spread_projector.py mirroring the WNBA file.
